document: Trial CT-88242 is a Phase 3 study of parsatide versus placebo-matched standard care, sponsored by Quarry Bio. The planned enrolment target was 500 patients; 452 patients were ultimately enrolled. The primary endpoint is time to first relapse; secondary endpoints include quality of life.

schema.drug_name: string: the investigational drug (not the comparator)
schema.enrolled_patients: integer: patients actually enrolled (not the planned target)
